name: Astronomical twilight
text: in astronomical twilight, sky black overhead, faintest gray tint low in the east, stars still sharp, land in near darkness

name: Pre-dawn
text: before dawn, deep indigo sky, faint glow on the horizon, last stars fading, cold still air

name: First light
text: at first light, gray-blue sky brightening in the east, colorless soft light, shapes emerging from darkness, no shadows yet

name: Dawn
text: at dawn, soft pale light, {pink|lavender|peach} glow along the horizon, thin morning mist, quiet stillness

name: City dawn
text: at dawn in the city, pale {pink|apricot|lavender} sky behind rooftops, streetlights still on, empty streets, cool blue shadows

name: Sunrise
text: at sunrise, pink and orange sky, fresh morning light

name: First rays
text: first rays of the rising sun, low golden light grazing treetops and rooftops, very long shadows, cool blue shade below

name: Early morning
text: in the early morning, sun just above the horizon, crisp pale light, cool air, long blue shadows, quiet empty surroundings

name: Morning
text: in the morning, clear fresh light, low sun casting long soft shadows, {dew on the grass|bright blue sky}

name: City morning
text: on a city morning, bright sun between buildings, sharp light and shade across the street, {commuters hurrying|cafes opening|delivery vans unloading}

name: Late morning
text: in late morning, bright clear sunlight, sun climbing high, crisp defined shadows, saturated colors, deep blue sky

name: Midday
text: at midday, sun high overhead, harsh bright light, short hard shadows, vivid colors

name: High noon
text: at high noon, white-hot sky, blinding glare straight overhead, shadows pooled directly under objects, bleached washed-out colors, shimmering heat

name: Early afternoon
text: in the early afternoon, sun just past its peak, strong warm light, shadows starting to lean, rich saturated colors, drowsy stillness

name: Afternoon
text: in the afternoon, warm even sunlight, sun slowly lowering, lengthening shadows, hazy blue sky

name: Late afternoon
text: in late afternoon, sun lowering in the west, long slanting light, stretched shadows, warm but still bright, dust motes in sunbeams

name: Golden hour
text: at golden hour, low warm sun, honey-colored light, long glowing shadows, soft rim light

name: City golden hour
text: at golden hour in the city, low sun flaring between buildings, glass towers glowing gold, long shadows down the street

name: Sunset
text: at sunset, fiery orange sky, long shadows

name: Last light
text: at last light, sun gone from the ground, only the highest {peaks|rooftops|treetops} still lit pink and gold, everything below in cool shade

name: Afterglow
text: in the afterglow, sun just below the horizon, sky glowing {pink|apricot|lavender|crimson}, soft warm light, dark silhouettes against the bright horizon

name: Blue hour
text: during the blue hour, deep cobalt twilight sky, glowing windows and street lights, cool soft shadowless light

name: Dusk
text: at dusk, last light fading on the horizon, dim {purple|rose and gray} sky, darkening silhouettes, first stars appearing

name: City dusk
text: at dusk in the city, skyline turning to silhouette against a {purple|rose|steel blue} sky, red beacons blinking on rooftops, first neon signs

name: Early evening
text: in the early evening, dim violet sky, house windows lighting up one by one, warm porch lights, last blue light fading

name: Evening
text: in the evening, sky darkened to deep navy, warm lamplight in soft pools, glowing interiors, a few early stars, calm unhurried mood

name: City evening
text: on a city evening, glowing shop fronts and restaurant terraces, busy lit sidewalks, headlights and taillights, deep navy sky

name: Late evening
text: in the late evening, sky fully dark, fewer lit windows, quieting streets, warm interior glow against cool blue night

name: Moonrise
text: at moonrise, {huge orange|pale gold|silver-white} moon low on the horizon, faint moonlight spreading over the land, deep blue sky

name: Night
text: at night, {moonlit|under a starry sky|lit by city lights}, deep blue darkness

name: Moonless night
text: on a moonless night, near-total darkness, sky thick with stars, {the milky way overhead|faint starlight on the land}, black silhouettes

name: City night
text: at night in the city, skyline of lit towers, orange glow of light pollution, starless sky, {neon reflections|light trails on the highway|empty lit avenues}

name: Midnight
text: at midnight, pitch-dark sky, {a full moon high above|a sky full of stars|a single glowing streetlight}, inky shadows, deep silence

name: Small hours
text: in the small hours, deserted silent streets, a few lone lit windows, buzzing streetlights, empty roads, deep stillness

name: Dead of night
text: in the dead of night, the whole world asleep, deepest darkness, barely visible outlines, cold still air, utter silence
